themes.name: Digital Civic Access
themes.rule: Proposals that improve residents' connectivity to, access to, navigation of, or transparency around municipal information and services, including online and in-person assistance.

themes.name: Affordable Housing
themes.rule: Proposals that increase affordable housing supply, improve housing conditions, or make housing costs and rental markets more accessible or transparent.

themes.name: Public Safety and Response
themes.rule: Proposals focused on preventing crime, improving personal safety in public places, policing, or speeding emergency response.

themes.name: Transit and Street Mobility
themes.rule: Proposals that improve public transit, cycling, or the safety and ease of moving along streets and roads.

themes.name: Health and Care Services
themes.rule: Proposals that expand medical, mental-health, preventive-health, or in-home care services for residents.

themes.name: Schools and Student Support
themes.rule: Proposals that improve school facilities, teaching, class conditions, student meals, or children's learning support and instruction.

themes.name: Parks and Outdoor Recreation
themes.rule: Proposals that create, green, or make accessible public outdoor spaces for recreation, play, gardening, or pets.

themes.name: Waste, Energy, and Pollution
themes.rule: Proposals that reduce waste or pollution, improve environmental monitoring, or shift city operations and consumption toward cleaner energy and materials.

themes.name: Culture and Public Arts
themes.rule: Proposals that expand access to libraries, museums, public art, performances, festivals, or other cultural activities.

themes.name: Local Jobs and Business Support
themes.rule: Proposals that help residents find or prepare for work, support local businesses, or make it easier to start and operate a business.
